4091-4613-6858.easyPrerequisites:
Oreskos Sun Guide doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Aphetto Alchemist is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4091-4613-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide using Aphetto Alchemist's ability by tapping it, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5708-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2511-3175-8207.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

116-512-8190.easyPrerequisites: Loot and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Loot, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
116-512-8190.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Loot's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

529-3197-6968-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1477-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature.
Repeat from step 1.

1981-2034-2415-7192.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2415-7452-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-6249-7920--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

2060-2713-5140-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2060-2713-5140-7803.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2713-5140-7803.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2092-3230-4954.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 7 power.
2092-3230-4954.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding two mana.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Coral Atoll and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

4359-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4359-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4359-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1833-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1833-5231-6972.notes: If Stormbound Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

5256-6553-7424.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

2105-7060-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

1374-3626-4460-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-4460-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

628-2438-7217.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

967-1308-2921-3809-7087.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

57-1251-4846-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1251-4846-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

539-5649-6517-6797.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1770-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

4050-5263-6243.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding one mana of any color.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, adding one mana of any color.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Repeat.

3129-5436-5742-5743.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1274-2034-2741-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-2741-3490.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1018-1987-4423-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least four Islands.
1018-1987-4423-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.

3698-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3698-5776-5777.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield as a Food due to Ygra, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1734-4681-5147.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2232-4445-4618.notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to any legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
2232-4445-4618.description:
Activate the legendary creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {3}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Instill Energy by paying {G}, attaching it to the legendary creature.
When Instill Energy enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Leyline Immersion to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping the legendary creature.
Cast Leyline Immersion by paying {3}{G}, attaching it to the legendary creature.
When Leyline Immersion enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Instill Energy to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

265-4559-4659-5272.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have a combined mana value of ten or greater.
265-4559-4659-5272.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, adding {C}{C}.
When Metlwork Colossus dies, Sly Requisitioner and Farid trigger.
Resolve the Sly Requisitioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Farid trigger, creating a Scrap artifact token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Servo and the Scrap token, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying at most {1}.
Repeat.

647-1550-2105.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant.
An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
647-1550-2105.description:
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3132-3750-4871.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block and kill Bladewing.
You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
2034-3132-3750-4871.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Bladewing.
Bladewing triggers, creating at least three 2/2 Zombie Knight creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Zombie Knights, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The Zombie Knights die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

565-2104-2493-4598.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of Archaeomancer.
The Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking the nontoken Archaeomancer.
The nontoken Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

708-2459-4753-5147.notablePrerequisites: Clever Impersonator is a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-2459-4753-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Repeat.

1322-2034-4289-5200-5251.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to Emmara, Soul of the Accord.
1322-2034-4289-5200-5251.description:
Use Cryptolith Rite to tap Emmara, Soul of the Accord for {1}.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord triggers creating a token creature.
Use Cryptolith Rite to tap the token creature for {1}.
Sacrifice the token creature to Ashnod's Altar floating {2}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns to untap Emmara, Soul of the Accord.
Repeat.
